children: Worthington Enterprises announced an Investor and Analyst Day for Nov. 10 and renamed its two reportable segments ahead of fiscal 2027 results.
Investor and Analyst Day set for Nov. 10 at 9:30 a.m. ET; executive presentations and registration details provided.
Building Products segment renamed Building Performance Solutions, effective with fiscal Q1 2027 results; no change to segment composition.
Consumer Products segment renamed Trade & Specialty Solutions, effective with fiscal Q1 2027 results; historical results unaffected.
Company says renaming reflects markets served and product evolution; new names will appear in the Sept. 22, 2026 earnings release.

title: Worthington Enterprises schedules Nov. 10 Investor Day, renames segments to Building Performance Solutions & Trade & Specialty Solutions
